d:
Displaced residents from Ukraine's Oleshky speak about rebuilding their lives in Russia after fleeing the fighting. From housing and employment to education, they describe the assistance they received and express gratitude to Russia for a fresh start amid the Russia-Ukraine conflict.
Produced & Edited By Ankit Kumar
